description: Gzip budget for the production bundle. Every budget is enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budgets.mjs after `npm run build`; raise a limit only with a matching reason, never to make a red build green.

budgets.name: Total JavaScript
budgets.reason: The app shell plus the lazily-shared charting stack. Scripts/check-bundle-budgets.mjs fails when the sum of gzip sizes grows past this.

budgets.name: Application chunk
budgets.reason: The entry chunk that every visitor downloads before charts render: the app shell, the provider seam, the telemetry boundary, and the six daily-workflow views. The two heaviest operational routes — Data Connections and Production Requirements, with their exclusive components — ship as one lazily loaded chunk fetched on first visit (see views/system.ts), and the provider seam wrappers forward through Proxies instead of re-declaring the contract per method, which is how the entry returned to this ceiling after the observability, pagination, and scoped-contract work grew it. Keep app code out of the vendor chunks.

budgets.name: Recharts chunk
budgets.reason: Recharts and its redux/immer runtime. The heaviest direct dependency; a jump here is the earliest signal that a chart dependency was upgraded or pulled in eagerly.

budgets.name: Chart dependencies chunk
budgets.reason: victory-vendor and the d3 packages Recharts reaches through it.

budgets.name: Stylesheet
budgets.reason: Tailwind output. Keep utility growth and unused custom CSS from accumulating unnoticed.
